description: Never lose the next mixed set. Huck tracks ABBA and OWWO/WOOW rotations automatically as the score changes, on iPhone and Apple Watch. Try 3 games free.

hero.sub: Pick your rotation and Huck advances the active set after every point, so nobody has to count lines on the sideline. Keep score and the set order in one place.

media.alt: Huck scoreboard with the active mixed set highlighted
Mixed set tracking on Apple Watch

faq.q: Which mixed-set patterns does Huck support?
faq.a: ABBA and OWWO/WOOW. Choose your rotation in game setup before you start.

faq.q: Does the set advance on its own?
faq.a: Yes. Huck advances the active set as the score changes, and the current set is shown on the scoreboard.

faq.q: Can I see the set on my wrist?
faq.a: Yes. With Apple Watch you can score and follow the active set from your wrist.

title: Huck – Ultimate Frisbee Workout & Score Tracker for Apple Watch
description: Keep score on your wrist while Huck records your Ultimate workout: duration, distance, active energy and heart rate. Built for Apple Watch. Try 3 games free.

hero.sub: Start a game on Apple Watch and Huck records your workout while you keep score. Review duration, distance, active energy and heart rate with the result when available.

media.alt: Huck workout screen on Apple Watch

faq.q: What does Huck record for my workout?
faq.a: Duration, distance, active energy and heart rate, shown alongside the game when available.

faq.q: Do I need an Apple Watch?
faq.a: Workout recording needs Apple Watch and Health permission. Without them, Huck still keeps score, sets and stats on iPhone and iPad.

faq.q: Is my Health data sent to analytics?
faq.a: Version 26.38 keeps exact Health metrics out of Huck's analytics, purchase, paywall and push providers. Read the privacy notice for the details.

faq.q: What can I track about my own play?
faq.a: Goals, assists and defences, added during play and saved with the game.

faq.q: Can I log stats from my wrist?

faq.q: Where do I see my stats afterwards?
faq.a: In the game summary and your saved game history.
